name: dad-joke
label: Dad Joke
description: Online sample connector that calls the icanhazdadjoke.com REST API. Demonstrates configuration, headers, and live HTTP calls.

fields.name: server_url
fields.title: API Base URL
fields.tooltip: Base URL for the dad joke API. Use https://icanhazdadjoke.com unless you have a mirror.

fields.name: user_agent
fields.title: User-Agent
fields.tooltip: icanhazdadjoke.com requires a descriptive User-Agent identifying your application and a contact URL.

operations.title: Joke by ID
operations.description: Fetches a specific dad joke by its ID.

parameters.name: joke_id
parameters.title: Joke ID
parameters.tooltip: The ID returned in the `id` field of a previous joke response.

operations.title: Search Jokes
operations.description: Searches dad jokes for a term.

parameters.name: term
parameters.title: Search Term
parameters.tooltip: Word or phrase to search for. Leave blank to list jokes without filtering.
